title: Working memory encoding and retrieval dynamics
abstract: We study memory encoding and retrieval process with controlled experiment measuring recall accuracy and robustness.

title: Spaced repetition improves long term recall accuracy
abstract: Randomized trial of spaced repetition schedule measuring retention rate and reliability across weeks.

title: Forgetting curve and interference failure modes
abstract: Failure analysis of forgetting and interference causing retrieval degradation and memory collapse under load.

title: Cache eviction policies mirror forgetting curves
abstract: Systems study of cache eviction and stale invalidation as failure mode with benchmark evaluation of hit rate.

title: Catastrophic forgetting in continual learning
abstract: Neural networks suffer catastrophic forgetting and interference; ablation and controlled comparison measure accuracy degradation.

title: Retrieval practice protocol with human annotation
abstract: Controlled evaluation protocol with human annotation measuring precision and recall of retrieval practice interventions.

title: Memory consolidation during sleep: mechanism review
abstract: Systematic review of consolidation mechanism linking encoding dynamics to long term storage architecture.

title: Benchmarking recall fidelity under stress testing
abstract: Stress testing and component-level assessment of recall fidelity with benchmark validity checks.

title: Hallucination and confabulation as retrieval failures
abstract: Analysis of hallucination and confabulation bias as failure mode with error rate measurement.

title: Interleaving vs blocking: comparative testing
abstract: Comparative testing and randomized trial of interleaving schedule measuring generalization performance.

title: The testing effect: meta analysis
abstract: Meta analysis of testing effect experiments measuring retention robustness across cohorts.

title: Distributed caching with trace analysis
abstract: Trace analysis of distributed cache behavior measuring hit rate consistency and stale failure modes.

title: Attention and encoding limits under cognitive load
abstract: Experimental study of attention mediation in encoding with controlled experiment and validity assessment.

title: Reproducible workflow for memory experiments
abstract: Reproducible workflow and evaluation protocol for memory studies with replication baseline.
